name: llama.cpp MTP variation with recovered PP TPS

mentions.name: llama.cpp MTP variation with recovered PP TPS
mentions.description: A variation of multi-token prediction (MTP) for llama.cpp that recovers prompt-processing throughput (PP TPS) back to the level seen with MTP disabled, while keeping most of MTP's benefits to text-generation throughput (TG TPS). It is planned to be proposed as a patch back to llama.cpp or provided as a fork.
mentions.problem: MTP degrades prompt-processing throughput (PP TPS) relative to running with MTP disabled.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a variation of MTP that recovers PP TPS (back to the same as with MTP disabled), keeping most of MTP's benefits to TG TPS.

evidence.value: I'm working on a variation of MTP that recovers PP TPS (back to the same as with MTP disabled), keeping most of MTP's benefits to TG TPS.
